subject: Pollination Services Request for Multi-Site Orchards
body_text:
Hello,

I hope this message finds you well! I’m reaching out to discuss our upcoming pollination needs for Mountain Valley Farms. We have three sites in Oregon: the Golden Orchard, which focuses on peaches, will need 20 hives from mid-April to the end of May. The Apple Grove, with a variety of apples, requires 25 hives, starting around March 25 through the first week of June. Lastly, our Cherry Hill site will need 15 hives from late April through the end of May.

In addition, we’d like to explore the possibility of restructuring our contract to accommodate these varying schedules. If there are any specific recommendations or adjustments you suggest, I’d love to hear your thoughts. We’re eager to ensure a smooth pollination process this season to maximize our yield.

Looking forward to your prompt response, as we need to finalize these arrangements soon!

Warm regards,  
Denise Davenport
